Buying in October leaves March below zero.

−$8,500

Projected cash in March 2027 · cushion $6,000

Why does timing matter?

The purchase reduces cash by $15,000 from October onward, leaving less to carry through the quiet months.

Bank balance today$52,400
Estimated spending room$500

Spending room accounts for planned bills, the cash cushion, and months when costs exceed income. It is not the bank balance.

Spending room uses the lower limit, never below zero. Monthly forecasts can miss cash gaps between payment dates.
